work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCLVI (address to Ignaz Demeter, archbishop of Freiburg, LF56503–56507) rebukes the clergy who joined the inauguration of the Protestant church, sends a Penitentiary rescript on marriage dispensations, and warns about mixed marriages, liturgical novelty and catechesis; LF56545 → LF56551 across page number 385 LF56548; LF56613 → LF56631 across own provenance LF56616 (Ex Archivio Epistolarum ad Principes), printer’s signature LF56619, sheet number 49 LF56622, a mark LF56625 and the page-386 head LF56628; complete 30 November 1839 closing followed by the retained editorial note LF56757. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF56508–56508; the source closing at LF56752–56754 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Mariam Maiorem die trigesima novembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo nono, pontificatus Nostri anno nono. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
